metadata.description: R2-068A Smart Money Data Audit - Availability, provenance, and integrity verification
metadata.objective: Determine whether historical smart-money data exists, identify the source, and document the correct availability status per R2-068A #6 (no hardcoded smart money)
metadata.dataUniverse: BACKTEST_UNIVERSE (6 validated BIST symbols: THYAO, AKBNK, ASELS, BIMAS, TUPRS, GARAN)

providersChecked: TCMB (Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey)

Yahoo Finance.notes: Yahoo Finance 1D provides only open, high, low, close, volume. No institutional flow, broker distribution, or ownership change data.
Yahoo Finance.pointInTimeSafety: N/A - no smart money data available

Alpha Vantage.notes: Not currently integrated into the market-data pipeline. Would require new API keys and pipeline.

Finnhub.notes: Not currently integrated into the market-data pipeline.

KAP.notes: KAP provides company metadata (foundation, sector) but not institutional flow or smart money signals for historical dates.
KAP.pointInTimeSafety: N/A - metadata only, not smart money flows

TCMB.notes: TCMB provides central bank interest rates and reserve data, not institutional equity flow data.
TCMB.pointInTimeSafety: N/A - macro rates, not smart money

MKK.notes: MKK provides market structure data but not institutional flow or smart money signals for BIST historical dates.
MKK.pointInTimeSafety: N/A - market structure, not smart money

Fintables.notes: Fintables provides research fundamental data, not historical institutional flow data for BIST symbols.
Fintables.pointInTimeSafety: N/A - research fundamentals, not smart money

codeAudit.classification: FORBIDDEN per R2-068A #6 - hard-coded market values
codeAudit.previousBehavior: The backtest engine received hardcoded smart money defaults (accumulationScore=50, institutionalActivity=neutral, distributionScore=30), making the component appear 'available' when no historical smart money data exists.
codeAudit.currentFixApplied: The smartMoney input to the opportunity engine is now null (R2-068A fix). The engine has been updated to handle null smartMoney gracefully (added null check guard in evaluateSmartMoney). The signal snapshot explicitly reports smartMoneyStatus = 'UNAVAILABLE'.
codeAudit.engineUpdate: apps/api/src/modules/opportunity/opportunity.engine.ts:evaluateSmartMoney method updated to accept SmartMoneyResult | null and return score=0, contribution=0 with riskFactors=['Smart money data unavailable'] when null is passed.

zeroVsUnavailable.currentBehaviorBeforeFix: smartMoney appeared to contribute score via weight=20 with accumulationScore=50 (above minAccumulationScore=30), giving a non-zero contribution to the total opportunity score. This was fabricated data presented as real.
zeroVsUnavailable.correctBehaviorAfterFix: smartMoney = null, smartMoneyStatus = 'UNAVAILABLE'. The opportunity score no longer includes fabricated smart money data. The 20 weight remains configured but the contribution is 0 when data is unavailable. This is the correct semantic: configuredWeight (20) !== availableContribution (0).
zeroVsUnavailable.documentedPrinciple: REAL DATA ONLY. NO FABRICATION. UNAVAILABLE ≠ 0 unless existing architecture explicitly defines this behavior AND it does not create a fabricated financial score. R2-068A corrects this by making unavailable explicit.
